avatar.name: The Night-Watch Newborn Mother
avatar.description: A mother of a congested newborn whose nights are built around a blocked nose: feeds stall, sleep shatters, and every gurgle restarts a private check. She has a hospital bulb and has heard of mouth-suction tubes; she feels mean when she clears and helpless when nothing shows.
avatar.awareness_notes: Solution-aware on saline, steam, bulb, NoseFrida-class tubes; problem-aware on night breathing. Cynical about 'clears instantly' claims.

pain_points.description: Congestion sounds like she cannot tell if the baby is getting air.
examples: She sounds like she can't breathe.
I keep checking his chest in the dark.
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

pain_points.description: Blocked nose breaks latch; the next wake comes before the last feed finished.
examples: Nothing works before the next bottle.
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

pain_points.description: Fear of what grows or hides inside a bulb she cannot see or wash through.
examples: What if something's growing in the bulb?
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

pain_points.description: Clearing feels like hurting them to help them.
examples: I feel so mean doing this.
She screams and I still have to finish.
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

pain_points.description: Mouth suction or disgust makes the job one parent's only.
examples: I couldn't hand him the tube.
He offered and I said no.
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

emotional_effects: 3am uncertainty without a way to know
Feeling incompetent in front of family
Fear this is the new forever

Putting something unclean in a tiny nose

product_fit.mechanism: Nasal aspirator with a clear collection cup so mucus is visible when removed; designed to be cleaned without a sealed hidden chamber and without mouth contact.
product_fit.how_it_resolves: Turns blind guessing into a visible clear-out and makes the job handoffable without mouth suction.
